snippet.title: Final Fantasy VII Regenesis (RPG Maker 2003) - Part 1
snippet.description:
Subscribe to see more: https://www.youtube.com/riggy2k3?sub_confirmation=1
Play my game, DELUGE: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1810410/DELUGE/
Also live on Twitch: https://www.twitch.tv/riggy2k3

Final Fantasy VII Regenesis is a non-profit game created by fans currently in development. This is a sequel to Final Fantasy VII (Advent Children and Dirge Of Cerberus). The main story takes place seven years after the events of Dirge of Cerberus.

Seven years after the events of Final Fantasy VII - Dirge Of Cerberus, Jenova sets in motion events that will again bring Cloud and all his friends and former enemies into the great battle that will decide the planet's final destiny.

Download the game here: https://rpgmaker.net/games/11321/
